name: App Sting
tagline: A 10–15 second looping sting of your app's screens: whip pans that match speed, taps, toasts and a number that counts up.
youSay: /app-sting A 12-second loop of these four screenshots for Orbit, brand colour #4B4BE8
whatYouGet: A seamless 10–15 second loop: your logo, then your screens in a phone or a browser, and back to the logo
Cuts that read as one move: both screens share every whip pan, with motion blur at the fastest frames
One action per screen: a tap (with a cursor on desktop screens), a toast that says what happened, or a sticker that counts up
MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 at up to 60 fps, plus the sting as an editable HTML page
goodFit: App Store and landing-page previews, conference bumpers
notFor: Explaining what a product does (make a launch video)
Products without real screens to show
youBring: 3–5 of your own screenshots, phone or desktop
Your name or logo, URL and brand colours
needs: Google Chrome or Edge (or Playwright's Chromium)

network.purpose: playwright-core for the renderer, installed once
